egrinda_already_given_gold_10.m: This gold will really help me rebuild my life. Now I just need to decide where to do that.

egrinda_already_given_gold_15.m: Nor City? Why would I ever want to live there?
r: I'm really not sure why except that I've met so many Shadow folk that rave about that place.

egrinda_already_given_gold_20.m: Feygard? Why would I ever want to live there?
r: Well, I've heard such wonderful things about that glorious city. There's so many opportunities for almost anyone.

egrinda_already_given_gold_25.m: Nor City? I don't know, maybe. But thank you for your suggestion.

egrinda_already_given_gold_30.m: Feygard? I don't know, maybe. But thank you for your suggestion.

egrinda_wants_gold_10.m: That gold you're holding... it belonged to my family. Stolen from us not long ago, taken by hands no better than yours.

egrinda_wants_gold_20.m: You can do right and give it back. Or you can learn what happens to those who carry what's not theirs.
r: If it's truly yours, then take it. [Hand over the recently looted gold.]
Oh, you mean that gold that now belongs to me? It's now mine.
[Lie] Oh, you mean the 500 gold pieces that I found back there? [Pointing west.]

egrinda_wants_gold_narrator_1.m: She takes a cautious step forward.
